test_resnet_scriptability: test that a ResNet backbone built with build_resnet_backbone can be scripted with torch.jit.script and produces matching outputs
test_fpn_scriptability: test that a ResNet-FPN backbone built with build_resnet_fpn_backbone can be scripted with torch.jit.script and produces matching outputs
build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone from a Detectron2 config and ShapeSpec using build_resnet_backbone
build_resnet_fpn_backbone: build a ResNet-FPN backbone from a Detectron2 config and ShapeSpec using build_resnet_fpn_backbone
review_TorchScript_backbone_tests: review the TestBackBone unittest class to understand how ResNet and FPN backbones are validated for TorchScript compatibility
